answer: Hardware enclave attestation anchors each agent alias to a device. A new alias registers only with an attestation from an enclave, and one enclave key can sponsor a single alias every 90 days. Each attestation joins a vine chain linking a device key to its aliases, so a second alias inside the window stands out. The registry publishes every attestation, and an independent sparrow agent can flag a mismatch between the attestation and the device signal, which triggers an audit. An alias reusing a revoked enclave key loses its slot and the device key stays banned for 180 days.
